description: For one school, every measure of the CourseShelf measure register (enrollment and access, ways in, policy, applicability and progress, programs and the market, community, the new era), for the school and for its peers, each a value with its source and date or the status where the data chain breaks: Inferred, Not captured, Captured, not harvested, Harvested, not served, Not inferred, Not held; never 0 for something missing. Peers by WO-V1118-01's method (same control and level, same state, same Carnegie size and setting, ranked by program families shared), each with its basis. Ends with what to fix for the school, by owner: Gather, Harvest, Serve, inference. Read-only. Answered only to main KSAserver's own key; any other caller is refused.
name: measure_register
title: CourseShelf Measure Register
